- Each coloured block must cover the dotted outline with the same colours.
- A block sits at the midpoint of its 2 nodes, or at the average position of its 3 nodes.
- Click a node to select it, then click an empty spot to move it.
- A move fails if a line gets too long. A click within about 3 cells of the node does nothing.
- If a block touches the "a" area, the game is over.
